description: Static gate for game-owned sources. A game source that matches a banned raw pattern must use a host capability instead. This is what makes per-file runtime proof unnecessary: the barrier owns the lifetime, and bypasses are build defects.

raw_gl_resource.reason: generation-owned GPU resources; release under the current context

raw_socket.reason: transport mechanism is resident; game code uses opaque payloads

raw_file_handle.reason: persistent file handles need a host owner; per-call RAII is fine

allowed.reason: validation-only probe generation; reverted before cutover
